chapters.name: Chapter 173: Chapter 173: Anti-Shura Armor!
chapters.content:
Savage Charge!

 

Once activated, the Savage Charge skill grants an invincible buff for five seconds and triples attack power!

 

Fenric's current strength stat was 303 points.

 

With the triple boost, his strength skyrocketed to an astonishing 909 points!

 

Terrifying!

 

To put this into perspective, a normal adult male has a strength attribute of around 10 points. Fenric's boosted strength was over 90 times greater than that of an ordinary human!

 

A normal man can punch with about 350 pounds of force. Based on this calculation, Fenric's current punch delivered a crushing 31,500 pounds of force—

 5

The equivalent of a full-speed locomotive smashing directly into the giant monster's face.

 

BOOM!!!

 

The earth trembled violently, and a deafening roar exploded through the streets.

 

The shockwave was so strong that shop windows on both sides of the street shattered instantly.

 

The giant monster's face caved in from the impact of Fenric's iron ball, as though a massive chunk of its skull had simply vanished.

 1

Its forward momentum stopped dead in its tracks!

 

Its massive body flipped backward due to inertia, then came crashing down.

 1

"BOOM—RUMBLE!!!"

 

The monster's enormous corpse flattened cars, crushed streetlights, and brought down several buildings along the roadside.

 

One punch.

 

One dead giant monster.

 

The Hulk had done such a feat before.

 

Now, Fenric had done it too.

 

Of course, Fenric knew he was cheating—his Savage Charge skill was temporary. When its effect ended, his true strength was far weaker compared to Hulk's raw, unrelenting power.

 2

But no one else knew that.

 

To everyone watching, Fenric had just one-punched a creature that none of them could even hold back!

 

"This man…" someone murmured.

 

"He's a monster…"

 

"..."

 

"What was that sound? Why did everyone suddenly go quiet? I don't like this silence." Black Widow's voice came through the comms.

 

She was busy rescuing hostages inside a building and hadn't seen what happened, only hearing the massive impact.

 

After a long pause, Hawkeye's voice came through, laced with disbelief.

 

"Did that guy… did he just Hulk out?!"

 

"Stark, listen to me." Captain America's tone was heavy. "Don't provoke that guy. Not now. I mean it."

 

Steve Rogers could now confirm without a doubt—Fenric had shown them mercy back in the Stark Tower.

 

If Fenric had used that kind of power back then, both he and Tony would have been in serious trouble.

 

Tony, unusually quiet, said nothing.

 

For once, the sarcastic billionaire had no quips left.

 

Fenric's display of power was terrifying—not just his strange abilities, but the fact that he killed the giant monster with a single strike.

 

But Tony Stark wasn't one to back down easily.

 

In his mind, plans were already forming.

 

"I'll design something better," he thought grimly. "A suit that can take down even the Shura God… My 'Anti-Shura Armor.'"

 3

(He heard his name from the Samsara players shouting earlier.)

 1

Meanwhile, on the S.H.I.E.L.D. helicarrier—

 

Nick Fury, the one-eyed director, stared intently at the live feed on the monitors.

 

The screen was filled with Fenric's figure.

 

Even Fury, who had seen Hulk's devastation firsthand, couldn't help but feel a tinge of fear.

 

"This guy…" he muttered. "He's even more dangerous than the Hulk."

 

The only saving grace was that Fenric didn't seem hostile—at least not yet.

 

"Hill!" Fury barked.

 

"Sir?" Maria Hill straightened beside him.

 

"I want everything on this man. Every scrap of information you can find. Three days after this war is over, I expect a full report on my desk."

 

"Understood, sir."

 

Meanwhile, the Samsara players were buzzing with excitement and disbelief.

 

"Holy crap, was that the Shura boss's real strength?!"

 

"I swear, that punch… Did he just kill a giant monster in one hit?!"

 

"Too terrifying! With this level of power, he might even earn an A-rank evaluation!"

 

"No joke, Shura's power isn't any weaker than the Hulk's! Maybe even stronger in some ways!"

 

"Wait, A-rank? No one gets that on the Sixth Stage! Even the legendary Adam only hit A-rank after the Thirteenth Stage dungeon!"

 3

"Still, you can't deny what we saw. Even if it's not full A-rank, he's damn close!"

 

"Forget his power. Did you see his defense? Those energy cannons barely left a mark! That's some insane mastery of Armament Haki!"

 

"Yeah, this guy's too scary. Thank god this dungeon doesn't have opposing camps. Imagine being on the opposite side of Shura God… you'd be dead in seconds!"

 

The chatter continued endlessly.

 

Fenric's display had shaken both allies and enemies alike.

 

The Chitauri army, however, was anything but impressed.

 

"ROAR! ROOOAAAR!!!"

 

Countless Chitauri soldiers screamed in rage upon seeing their prized war beast fall.

 1

The aliens swarmed toward Fenric with renewed fury.

 

Fenric grinned.

 

"Alright… I think I've played around long enough."

 

It was time.

 

Time to move on to the next part of his plan.

 

After this performance, he was certain—S.H.I.E.L.D. would treat him as a VIP the next time the "Avengers 2" dungeon rolled around.

 

Aurora had already hinted at what was coming. Fenric needed to secure his standing now.

 

With a smirk, Fenric summoned the Mark VII armor.

 

"Clank! Click! Ka-cha!"

 3

The mechanical plates snapped into place, wrapping around him piece by piece.

 

In moments, the Shura God transformed into another imposing "Iron Man," gleaming in red and gold under the war-torn skies.

 

"What the… Did Shura just steal Tony Stark's style?!"

 

"No way, that's definitely Iron Man's tech!"

 

"Damn, this is way too cool! I want one too!"

 

"Yeah, like anyone would give you one. You're not exactly Shura God material."

 1

"He's so badass! Imagine wearing that armor to pick up girls—instant success!"

 

"Keep dreaming. Only someone like Shura could get away with stealing Tony Stark's suit and still look better than him in it!"

chapters.name: Chapter 174: Chapter 174: A Weak Evil God!
chapters.content:
Fenric shot into the sky, clad in the Mark VII armor, his movements swift and precise.

 

The Avengers paused for a moment, watching him streak past.

 

"Tony, was that you flying by just now?" Black Widow asked, unable to hide her confusion.

 

"No! That was the damn thief!" Tony said, his voice full of irritation.

 

Hawkeye chuckled. "Now I get it. No wonder Tony hates that monster-like guy so much. This is even worse than the 'green Tony.'"

 4

"Enough chatter," Captain America interjected firmly. "Right now, he's on our side. We'll deal with everything else once the battle's over."

 

"Copy that, Captain," Hawkeye replied, then suddenly exclaimed, "Wait—look! He's chasing Loki!"

 

High Above the City

 

Fenric had already spotted Loki's chariot and immediately gave chase.

 

The scepter, the Mind Stone itself, was still in Loki's hand.

 

Because of the Samsaras' intervention, the original timeline had already shifted.

 

There was no nuclear missile threatening Manhattan.

 

Loki hadn't directly joined the battlefield but instead commanded the Chitauri from above.

 

Thus, the scepter remained firmly in Loki's possession.

 

Fenric's objective was clear.

 

On one hand, he intended to hand the scepter over to S.H.I.E.L.D., ensuring they'd know how to shut down the space-time portal. (A strategic move, especially for preparing for Avengers 2.)

 

On the other hand, he wanted to test something—

 

Would an Infinity Stone be recognized as a special item by his system?

 

If it counted, he'd be unimaginably rich.

 1

The moment Fenric made his move, countless Chitauri ships swarmed after him.

 

These aerial vehicles were an annoyance—just as they had been for Iron Man.

 

Their energy cannons could easily pierce Tony's armor, which was built from lightweight alloy for better maneuverability at the cost of heavy defense.

 1

A single direct hit would leave visible damage.

 

But Fenric wasn't Tony.

 

His grandmaster-level Armament Haki enveloped the Mark VII armor, reinforcing its defenses far beyond its original design.

 2

On top of that, Fenric's psychic barrier shielded him further.

 

He ignored the pursuing Chitauri, focusing solely on Loki.

 

On his way, a massive Chitauri war beast lunged to intercept him.

 

Fenric didn't hesitate. With a flash of black steel, Shusui, his black blade, sliced through the creature—disassembling it into eight clean pieces mid-air.

 

Shusui's cutting power was unparalleled. Aside from Admiral Fujitora's blade in the "One Piece" dungeon, nothing had withstood Shusui's edge until now.

 1

Compared to Shusui, even the Chitauri's massive beasts had weaker defense than steel armor.

 

With Shusui in hand and the mobility of the Mark VII, Fenric closed in on Loki, unstoppable.

 

From afar, Loki's expression darkened.

 

He could see Fenric cutting a path toward him like a relentless predator.

 

But Loki didn't run.

 

As the commander of the Chitauri army, to flee now—in front of everyone—would ruin any hope of ruling Midgard.

 

"STOP! I AM A GOD!" Loki roared furiously. "How dare you, a mere mortal, challenge me?!"

 2

BOOM!

 

Fenric's answer was simple—a steel fist to the face.

 

The punch sent Loki tumbling off his chariot, slamming into the ground below.

 

With one decisive strike, the scepter flew from Loki's hand and landed in Fenric's grasp.

 

The moment Fenric touched it, he felt something strange—

 

A surge of desire, as if his deepest impulses were being magnified.

 

"Is this… the power of an Infinity Stone?" Fenric muttered. "Too bad. The system didn't give any notification—so it's not counted as a special item."

 3

He glanced at the glowing gem on the scepter one last time, then tossed aside the thought of keeping it.

 

After dispatching a few more Chitauri soldiers, Fenric made his way toward Captain America, who was barely holding the line.

 

The Captain's face was pale, his breaths ragged.

 

Hours of non-stop battle had worn him down. Even with his enhanced physique, he was nearing his limit.

 

"Captain!"

 

Fenric cut down a few Chitauri who were closing in on Steve.

 

"Thanks," the Captain said, panting as he looked at Fenric, unsure what the mysterious warrior planned to do.

 

"This scepter can close the space-time portal," Fenric said bluntly.

 

He tossed the scepter toward the Captain.

 

"What?!"

 

Steve caught it, stunned. "Are you sure about this?"

 

Fenric grinned. "Of course I'm sure. I'm an honest man—why would I lie? If you don't believe me, test it yourself. Need me to give you a lift?"

 

"…Then I'll take you up on that." Steve nodded.

 

Fenric grabbed his arm. "Hold on tight, Captain."

 

WHOOSH!

 

In a flash, Fenric shot into the sky with Steve in tow, heading straight for the top of Stark Tower.

 

Within seconds, they landed on the rooftop.

 

Steve quickly looked over the instrument connected to the Tesseract. Then he turned to Fenric.

 

"If you know how to shut it down, why don't you do it yourself?"

 

Fenric's helmet retracted, revealing his calm face. "Because I have something else to take care of."

 

His tone shifted, becoming solemn as he began to act the part of a hero:

 

"Captain, these aliens already know Earth's location. Even if we win today, they'll return. I intend to take the fight to their nest—to wipe them out completely."

 

"What!?"

 

Steve's eyes widened. "That's far too dangerous!"

 

Fenric smirked. "I know. But some things… someone has to do it."

 3

"..."

 

For a moment, Steve didn't know how to judge him.

 

Was Fenric a villain or a hero?

 

He had been reckless, unpredictable—yet now, his actions were undeniably heroic.

 2

"Time's running out," Fenric said. "When I enter the portal, close it using the scepter. Understood?"

 

Steve tightened his grip on the weapon. "…Be careful out there."

 

"No worries, Captain. I hope we meet again."

 

With a confident smile, Fenric's helmet snapped shut, and he soared skyward—straight toward the space-time portal.

 

Watching his retreating back, the rest of the Avengers felt a strange heaviness in their chests.

 

Steve had kept the comms open the entire time, so every word between Fenric and the Captain had been broadcast to all of them.

chapters.name: Chapter 175: Chapter 175: Purple Sweet Potato Appears!
chapters.content:
"Did you all hear what he said?" the Captain asked, his tone carrying both awe and concern.

 

"Hard to believe those heroic words came from a guy who robbed me," Tony muttered, sounding more annoyed than ever.

 

Hawkeye smirked. "Stark, I think there's been some misunderstanding. Maybe he took your armor because he had no other choice."

 

"No! No misunderstanding, Robin," Tony snapped, deliberately teasing Hawkeye with the nickname. "He's a thief! He stole two of my armors! Both of them were my latest, top-tier models!" His voice dripped with frustration.

 

The Captain cut in, his voice firm. "Focus. He's already entered the space portal. I'm going to shut it down. Next step—counterattack!"

 

The team immediately straightened, their fighting spirit reignited.

 

"Understood, Captain!"

 

Outer Space

 

Fenric soared through the portal, emerging into the dark void of space.

 

"Warning! Master, you have entered outer space. The armor's oxygen reserve is insufficient. Please return to Earth's atmosphere as soon as possible," Tsunade's voice—calm but urgent—echoed in his mind.

 

Fenric chuckled. "Relax, Tsunade."

 

Opening his mask, he was instantly assaulted by a crushing force. His blood vessels pulsed dangerously. If not for his inhuman physique, they would have burst on the spot.

 

Outer space was lethal.

 

No air. No pressure.

 1

The drastic pressure difference alone could make an ordinary human's body swell and rupture.

 2

Even if one could somehow breathe, they wouldn't survive for long.

 

Fenric wasn't ordinary, but even he couldn't stay out here forever.

 

"Master, you're doing something extremely reckless," Tsunade's voice urged again. "In your current condition, ten minutes out here is enough to kill you."

 

"Ten minutes?" Fenric grinned. "Plenty of time."

 

He took out an advanced oxygen mask. The moment it touched his face, it molded seamlessly to his features, allowing him to breathe naturally.

 

Re-sealing his armor helmet, Fenric asked, "Tsunade, how's my status now?"

 

"Master, with that mask, you can survive until your armor's energy runs out."

 

Fenric glanced at the energy indicator—56% remaining.

 

"More than enough."

 

Ahead, the void was filled with massive Chitauri warships.

 

The largest one—like a colossal floating fortress—loomed in the shadows, its hull glinting with a cold, metallic sheen.

 

The Chitauri had already spotted him. They rushed toward him in a storm of ships and beasts.

 

Though their mouths opened in furious roars, Fenric heard nothing—space swallowed all sound.

 

Fenric opened his mask slightly, eyes blazing with a cold, imperious light.

 

Om—

 

Fenric's Conqueror's Haki erupted.

 

An invisible wave tore through the void, distorting the very space around him.

 

In an instant, countless Chitauri soldiers lost consciousness, their bodies floating unconscious. Their ships, suddenly unmanned, collided with each other and exploded—silent, fireless bursts in the vacuum.

 2

Fenric's current mastery of Conqueror's Haki was at the Proficient level—powerful enough to overwhelm ordinary enemies with ease.

 4

The Chitauri soldiers weren't dead, merely knocked out cold.

 3

Even so, the result was devastating. Within moments, the entire void fell silent—except for the few massive war beasts still charging.

 

"Perfect," Fenric muttered. "Clears out the trash in one sweep."

 

Without this ability, mowing down millions of Chitauri would take him days.

 

But now, with a single glare, the battlefield was his.

 

Inside the Chitauri Warship

 

A black-robed commander stared in disbelief as Fenric single-handedly wiped out his forces. Panic gripped him.

 

He scrambled to a console, frantically activating the communication link.

 

Moments later, a holographic projection filled the chamber.

 

Seated on a dark throne was a Titan—his massive frame covered in golden armor, his expression cold and commanding.

 

His skin was a deep violet, his gaze sharp like a blade.

 

The black-robed commander dropped to his knees. "Master!"

 

The Titan's deep, ancient voice rumbled through the projection. "Why do you call me?"

 

"My lord," the commander stammered, his head low, "there is a powerful human. He has disrupted our plans, closed the portal, and is attacking KTYB-11."

 

The Titan tilted his head, a hint of interest flickering in his eyes. "Oh?"

 

"What are your orders?" the commander asked nervously.

 

"Hold your position. I will come."

 

Boom—

 

Fenric's thrusters flared, propelling him toward the giant warship.

 

The remaining beasts lunged to intercept him.

 

Their sheer size made them dangerous, but also predictable.

 

Fenric danced between them, his movements swift and lethal.

 

Still, these creatures had clearly been ordered to stop him at any cost—even if it meant colliding with each other.

 

______

chapters.name: Chapter 176: Chapter 176: I Have Been Waiting for You for a Long Time!
chapters.content:
Truthfully, Fenric was no match for the Hulk in terms of raw strength in a one-on-one fight.

 

The reason the Chitauri commander feared him was not due to brute power alone, but because of Fenric's versatile abilities—abilities that, in many ways, far surpassed what the Hulk could achieve.

 

Take his Conqueror's Haki, for example. While it had little effect on true powerhouses, its ability to instantly incapacitate ordinary soldiers made it far deadlier than most weapons—perhaps even more effective than the entire Avengers team combined when dealing with large enemy forces.

 1

The giant beasts received the Chitauri commander's order: stop Fenric at all costs.

 

Though clumsy in movement, their sheer numbers formed a formidable "monster wall" in front of him.

 

But the more they tried to block his path, the more it stirred Fenric's ferocity.

 

Fenric knew the truth about this invasion.

 

On the surface, it seemed like Loki's scheme, but behind the scenes, the true mastermind was none other than the "Mad Titan" – Thanos!

 

Loki was nothing but a pawn—a decoy.

 

"Tsunade, maximum energy to the thrusters!" Fenric commanded.

 

"Understood, Master."

 

Boom!

 

Flames erupted from Fenric's thrusters as he shot forward like a blazing comet, the black blade Shusui flashing in his grip. His Armament Haki enveloped the battle armor, adding another layer of lethal precision to his strikes.

 

One by one, the giant beasts fell as Fenric carved a bloody path.

 

"Puff!"

 

After minutes of relentless fighting, Fenric emerged from the body of a slain monster, his armor smeared with gore.

 

The blockade had finally been breached.

 

With no hesitation, he launched himself toward the largest Chitauri warship.

 

"Whizz—Whizz—"

 

Twin laser beams shot from the ship's cannons, cutting through the void like silent death.

 

Puff!

 

Fenric reacted a second too late—one of the beams slammed into him.

 

Boom!

 

The impact sent him flying, spinning uncontrollably.

 

The Chitauri's mothership-mounted energy cannons were no joke. The power behind a single shot was comparable to modern human missiles—and in the vacuum of space, there was no shockwave to warn him.

 

"Master, armor defense is down by 67%!" Tsunade's voice rang urgently.

 3

Fenric gritted his teeth.

 

If not for his Armament Haki, that shot would have destroyed his armor outright.

 4

Anger flared in his chest.

 

This wasn't just about the fight—he actually liked this armor, even if it was mainly a toy for flight.

 

And now, these alien tin cans dared to damage it?!

 

Fenric reignited his thrusters and surged forward, this time weaving sharply to avoid the aiming cannons. Another hit would mean the armor's end.

 

After a tense approach, Fenric finally landed on the warship's surface.

 

The massive vessel stretched for over a kilometer—an entire floating fortress.

 

On its deck, Fenric's figure looked insignificant, like an ant on the back of a dragon.

 

But the black blade Shusui gleamed coldly in his hands.

 

Without searching for an entrance, Fenric simply stabbed the blade into the hull, cutting through the steel as though it were paper.

 

"Haa—"

 

As soon as he tore open a gap, the internal air pressure rushed outward violently, creating a silent vacuum storm.

 

An ordinary human would have been sucked out instantly.

 

But Fenric, with his monstrous strength and Armament Haki, strode forward as if nothing had happened.

 

"Clang!"

 

A heavy blast door slammed down in front of him, attempting to block his advance.

 

Fenric sneered. "A mere door? Dream on."

 

Shing—Shing—

 

A few swift strikes from Shusui carved a gaping hole through the barrier.

 

From the corridor ahead came the pounding of boots.

 

A squad of fully armed Chitauri rushed at him, screeching, only to be cut down mercilessly in seconds.

 

Even knowing they were going to die, they threw themselves forward, desperate to delay him.

 

The Chitauri commander's plan was working—Fenric's progress slowed.

 

These new soldiers were smarter too, each wearing a reinforced helmet that greatly reduced the effect of Fenric's Conqueror's Haki.

 5

When he unleashed it again, they merely froze for a moment, dazed but not fainting outright.

 

"Puff! Puff!"

 

One after another, the soldiers fell, torn apart by Fenric's blade. His kill count was astounding.

 

But he wasn't smiling. His expression was cold, focused, and furious.

 

"Tsunade, how far to the ship's core?"

 

"Approximately 70 meters, Master."

 1

"Good. We're close."

 

As Fenric moved deeper, something changed.

 

The Chitauri soldiers vanished.

 

No more ambushes.

 

No more sealed blast doors.

 

It was as if the warship was deliberately letting him through.

 

"Something is wrong," Fenric muttered, his instincts on edge.

 

He discreetly tightened the grip on his Ark Ferry Ticket and checked the warp bracelet on his wrist.

 

If anything went wrong, he was ready to vanish in an instant.

 

Soon, he passed through a shimmering metal gate and entered a vast, empty chamber.

 

"Master, the Earthling is here."

 

A low, ominous voice broke the silence.

 

Fenric's gaze snapped toward the speaker—a black-robed figure.

 

He recognized him instantly. The Chitauri commander.

 

But what made Fenric's breath hitch was the figure standing beside him.

 

A towering warrior clad in heavy golden armor.

 

Skin purple as twilight, muscles like carved stone, standing easily over two meters tall.

 3

Fenric's pupils contracted sharply.

 

The Mad Titan. Thanos!

chapters.name: Chapter 177: Chapter 177: Thanos! (1/8)
chapters.content:
Behind Thanos stood two figures.

 

One was a thin, eerie-looking man with sharp, monkey-like features and an unsettlingly elegant demeanor—Ebony Maw.

 

The other was a bald, half-human, half-cybernetic woman—Nebula.

 

Fenric's expression turned grim the moment he saw this lineup.

 

Nebula was not a serious threat, but Ebony Maw was another matter entirely.

 

Among the feared Black Order, Ebony Maw was considered one of the most dangerous.

 1

His power—telekinetic manipulation—was similar to Fenric's telekinetic ability, but far more refined and deadly.

 

In Avengers: Infinity War, Ebony Maw's performance had been terrifying. He had effortlessly overwhelmed Doctor Strange and even toyed with Iron Man and Spider-Man, all while barely lifting a finger.

 

And standing next to him was someone far more terrifying—Thanos himself.

 

At that moment, Fenric actually felt the urge to use his Warp Bracelet and flee immediately.

 2

If he hadn't known the original plot—if he didn't understand that Thanos was more of a cold idealist than a bloodthirsty maniac—he might have bolted already.

 

"Earthling, welcome," Thanos said at last, his deep voice carrying a strange weight. There was genuine curiosity in his tone as he observed Fenric.

 

"..."

 

Fenric exhaled slowly and replied with feigned respect,

 

"It's… an honor. I didn't expect to meet you here, Mad Titan."

 

Before Thanos could respond, Ebony Maw snapped sharply,

 

"Watch your tone! You dare call my lord by name? Show respect!"

 1

Ebony Maw's eyes narrowed as he prepared to strike, but Thanos casually raised a hand to stop him.

 

"You know me?" Thanos asked, tilting his head, his voice surprisingly calm.

 

"Of course. You are Thanos, the Conqueror. Your name is known even on Earth," Fenric answered, his gaze unwavering.

 

Fenric ignored Ebony Maw's menacing glare. While the telekinetic warrior was powerful, Fenric wasn't exactly weak.

 

If it came to a direct fight, the outcome was far from certain.

 

Doctor Strange had been utterly crushed by Ebony Maw because Strange's physical resistance was too weak. Fenric, however, was protected by Armament Haki and monstrous strength. Even telekinetic binds might not hold him.

 

"Since you know me," Thanos said with a faint smile, "why stand against me?"

 

"The Earth is my home," Fenric replied with a casual shrug. "I can't just watch you destroy it."

 1

This was, of course, pure nonsense. To Fenric, this world was just another mission instance. He was only pretending to care.

 

Thanos studied him for a moment, seemingly convinced.

 

"Interesting. I will give you an opportunity. Serve me. If you pledge loyalty, I will ensure Earth remains unharmed."

 1

"..."

 

Fenric blinked, feigning surprise. He hadn't expected Thanos to actually recruit him.

 

But after a moment of thought, it made sense.

 

Thanos had sent Loki to retrieve the Infinity Stones. Clearly, Loki had failed—Fenric's presence aboard the warship was proof of that.

 

Thanos knew Earth was dangerous, and he wasn't ready to confront it personally until certain key defenders—like the Sorcerer Supreme—were no longer obstacles.

 2

Recruiting Fenric was his way of using an Earthling to do his work.

 

Fenric pretended to hesitate.

 

"If I were to serve you… you promise you won't invade Earth?"

 

In reality, he was stalling for time.

 

There was still over an hour left on his mission timer. If he used his Warp Bracelet now, there was a chance Thanos could still pursue him.

 

But if he delayed until the very end of the mission, he could vanish back to Samsara Space safely, no matter what happened.

 

Fenric still had an Ark Ferry Ticket, which would teleport him instantly to a safe location, but that item was worth 65,000 points!

 

Using it now would be a colossal waste.

 

Ebony Maw sneered, his voice dripping with disdain.

 

"How dare you question the word of my lord? Lord Thanos never breaks his promises!"

 

Fenric gave him a flat, uninterested glance.

 

"Your flattery skills are impressive," he said dryly before looking back at Thanos.

 

"Give me some time to think it over."

 

Thanos frowned slightly. Normally, anyone who didn't immediately accept his offer would be executed on the spot.

 

But Fenric was different.

 

Thanos needed someone strong—and someone who understood Earth.

 

"How long do you need?" Thanos asked. "My time is valuable. Don't test my patience."

 

"One hour," Fenric replied casually. "I'm… slow to make decisions. I need to think through what it would mean to serve you."

 

Thanos narrowed his eyes but, after a pause, nodded.

 

"Fine. One hour."

 2

Fenric sat cross-legged on the floor, pretending to meditate deeply.

 

Thanos, Nebula, and Ebony Maw watched in silence.

 

The latter two looked extremely impatient, but none of them dared to speak while Thanos tolerated it.

 

(Side note: In the comics, Ebony Maw is notorious for his manipulative flattery and cunning schemes. The movie version downplays this trait, so I'm leaning closer to the comic portrayal.)

 1

chapters.name: Chapter 178: Chapter 178: The Purple Sweet Potato’s Face Turns Purple! (2/8)
chapters.content:
One hour passed in the blink of an eye.

 

"Master, the time is up," Ebony Maw reminded in a low, respectful voice.

 

Thanos, seated on his floating throne, slowly opened his eyes and fixed his gaze on Fenric.

 

"Earthling," he said with calm authority, "have you made your decision? Will you surrender, or shall I destroy you?"

 

The Titan's patience was wearing thin.

 

"If I surrender, what exactly do you expect me to do?" Fenric asked, still buying time.

 

"Obey my commands," Thanos replied flatly, clearly unwilling to waste words on explanations.

 

At that moment, the long-awaited system prompt finally appeared in Fenric's mind:

 

[Warning: Only 10 minutes remain before the mission concludes.]

 

A slow smile formed on Fenric's lips.

 

"Alright, Thanos," Fenric said, his tone suddenly shifting. "Here's my choice— bye! "

 

Before Thanos could react, Fenric smashed the "Shatter and Dissolve" vial against the floor.

 

Crack!

 

The glass tube burst apart, and a sinister red liquid spread across the metal floor of the warship.

 

Sizzle! Sizzle!

 

The steel beneath Fenric's feet began to dissolve at an alarming rate, as though it were made of paper being eaten away by a supercharged acid.

 

The red substance spread outward in all directions, devouring the metal plating and leaving behind nothing but gaping holes and vaporized debris.

 

Fenric was momentarily stunned.

 

Too strong!

 

The corrosive effect of "Shatter and Dissolve" was far more terrifying than he expected.

 

Even Thanos narrowed his eyes, his expression darkening as the crimson liquid crept toward him.

 

"Master, I can't stop it!" Ebony Maw shouted in frustration, his telekinetic powers useless against the dissolving agent. The red liquid clung to anything it touched, devouring it without mercy—like the blood of a demon.

 

The Chitauri leader nearby panicked.

 

"Master, the ship will be destroyed! We must evacuate!"

 

Thanos' gaze locked onto Fenric, his deep voice rumbling like distant thunder.

 

"Earthling, you will pay with your life for this insolence!"

 

But Fenric was already retreating toward the breach he had created.

 

"Catch me first," he said with a mocking grin.

 

Suddenly, an invisible force clamped down on him—Ebony Maw's telekinetic grip. Fenric felt his body being dragged back.

 

"Hmph… I'm done playing with you," Fenric muttered coldly. "Goodbye."

 

The next instant, his figure vanished—teleporting away before Ebony Maw could tighten his hold.

 

"Master! He teleported!" Ebony Maw exclaimed, stunned by Fenric's sudden disappearance.

 

Thanos' expression turned grim.

 

"Leave. Now," he commanded. "The ship won't last."

 

Even Thanos had to admit, this corrosive solution was unlike anything he had encountered. He had the body of an eternal Titan, but even he doubted he could withstand that substance.

 

Within moments, Thanos and his subordinates abandoned the Chitauri flagship, retreating to his own warship, Sanctuary II.

 

From the viewport of Sanctuary II, they looked back at the Chitauri ship.

 

What had once been a massive war vessel—nearly the size of a city—was now reduced to fragments.

 

The rest of it had dissolved into nothingness.

 

Ebony Maw and Nebula stood in stunned silence.

 

Even Thanos' face darkened.

 

Such power…

 

If that human had brought this substance aboard Sanctuary II, even Thanos' flagship could have shared the same fate.

 

Earth, New York Battlefield

 

Though the Captain had closed the space-time portal, many Chitauri troops still roamed the city.

 

Captain America, Iron Man, and the others were still fighting relentlessly.

 

Even the Samsara players had emerged from hiding to kill a few more aliens in the final minutes, hoping to improve their mission evaluation scores.

 

Then, without warning—

 

All the Chitauri collapsed at once, as if their souls had been ripped away.

 

Even the towering leviathans crashed from the skies, their hulking bodies smashing into buildings like falling meteors.

 

The battlefield fell silent.

 

"Captain, what just happened?" Black Widow's voice crackled over the comms. "Did you do this? Or was it from the Samsara team?"

 2

"Not me," Captain America replied, breathing heavily. "But I have a feeling… it's that guy. He must have destroyed the Chitauri mothership."

 

"..."

 

"Incredible. He really saved the Earth," Hawkeye said in awe.

 

"Hey, don't forget," Tony interjected. "Half of that credit belongs to my armor! Without my tech, that guy wouldn't even get off the ground!"

 

"Tell Fury to start cleanup," the Captain said, sounding exhausted.

 

Meanwhile, the Samsara Players on the battlefield were buzzing with chatter:

 

"What the hell? All these Chitauri just dropped dead out of nowhere!"

 

"I checked the strategy guide—there's no mention of this happening!"

 

"Could it be… the Shura Boss? Didn't he sneak into the Chitauri mothership?"

 

"Holy crap, you're right! It must be him!"

 

"The Shura Boss is insane—SSS-tier godlike insane!"

 

"I swear, this is the gap between us weaklings and true monsters like him."

 

"So this is how you get an SSS-level evaluation? By wiping out the entire alien army?!"

 

"Yeah, sure, you go do it next time. I'll watch."

 

"Hah! Shura Boss' strategies are only for Shura Boss. Us weaklings can only watch and clap."

 

"I'm fine with it. With four or five hundred Chitauri kills, I should at least bag an A-rank score," one said.

 

"A-rank? Damn, I only managed a thousand kills… think I can scrape an S-rank?"

 2

"Get lost, you show-off!"

 

With the enemies gone, countless Samsara players regrouped and chatted while waiting for the system to pull them back.

 

In Outer Space

 

Ebony Maw suddenly pointed toward the depths of the void.

 

"Master, I've located that Earthling!"

chapters.name: Chapter 179: Chapter 179: Three Super God Evaluations
chapters.content:
The maximum range of Fenric's bracelet transmission was only five kilometers.

 

But in the vastness of space, what was five kilometers?

 

At the speed of light, even a sneeze could cover that distance in an instant.

 

So it didn't take long for Ebony Maw to locate Fenric again.

 

"Catch him!" Thanos ordered, his deep voice carrying a fury that could crush mountains.

 1

This human had dared to humiliate him. Thanos' eyes burned with anger.

 

With that command, the Sanctuary II—Thanos' colossal warship—ignited its engines and surged toward Fenric like a predator.

 

As one of the most advanced warships in the galaxy, Sanctuary II possessed an extraordinary propulsion system.

 

Its maximum speed could reach 0.3 times the speed of light, and its curvature navigation system allowed it to jump into faster-than-light travel when needed.

 

Buzz!

 

The massive ship roared forward, closing the gap between itself and Fenric like a steel beast.

 

Far away, Fenric floated calmly in the void, battle armor gleaming under the distant stars.

 

He did not run.

 

A faint smile curved his lips as he watched Sanctuary II bearing down on him.

 

Truthfully, while aboard the Chitauri mothership, Fenric had considered using the "Shatter and Dissolve" solution directly on Thanos.

 

But he knew the chance of success was slim.

 

Thanos was no fool—his reaction speed and Ebony Maw's interference would make it nearly impossible to hit him directly.

 

Just then, the system prompt echoed in Fenric's mind:

 

[Mission Countdown: 10… 9… 8… 7…]

 

Hearing this, Fenric's grin widened.

 

He raised his hand and gave Sanctuary II a cheeky wave, as if mocking Thanos.

 

In the next moment—

 

All the Samsara players within this dungeon world, including Fenric, vanished.

 

"Master! He's gone again!" Ebony Maw said with frustration.

 

Thanos remained silent, staring into the endless void outside the viewport, his eyes cold and heavy.

 

The appearance of this mysterious human filled him with an ominous premonition.

 

"Master, since that useless god's plan failed, should we proceed to attack Earth directly?" Ebony Maw asked cautiously.

 

Thanos finally spoke, his tone light but firm:

 

"No. We return home."

 

Attacking Earth now was not the right time.

 

A Supreme Sorcerer and an Odin—both ancient, formidable beings—still stood guard there.

 1

Even Thanos would not move rashly.

 

Samsara Space 

 

Suddenly, an announcement boomed across the vast Samsara space:

 

"Congratulations to Samsara Player—Shura!

 

In the dungeon world 'Avengers,' Shura displayed exceptional performance, annihilating the entire Chitauri army within 10 hours.

 

Mission over-completed.

 

Final Evaluation: SSS – Super God!"

 6

Super God!

 

The voice of the Samsara system reverberated like thunder, leaving countless Samsaras frozen in shock.

 

This was the third broadcast tonight announcing an SSS-tier Super God evaluation!

 

Three super god evaluations in a single night—

 

And all three were tied to the same person.

 

Shura.

 

He earned two of them himself… and assisted with another.

 

"Holy Cow! Did he just clear two dungeons in one night? Both with SSS evaluations?"

 

"Shura Boss, are you even human??"

 

"God-tier Shura, you're breaking our spirits here!"

 

"I'm done! I should just log off and sleep early. This is too depressing!"

 

"Ten hours to wipe out the entire Chitauri army? Even S-class Adam couldn't pull that off!"

 

"Shura Boss isn't even playing the same game as us anymore!"

 

"Every time I hear that name, I'm reminded how trash I am…"

 

"Where the hell does he get all those dungeon cooldown refresh cards? It's insane!"

 

"I heard Aurora Morwyn is funding him—buying the cards for Shura."

 

"Wait, is Shura planning to challenge Adam for 33rd-floor authority?"

 1

"Don't joke about it—No! At this pace, it's actually possible!"

 

The entire Samsara space was in an uproar.

 

Shura's achievements tonight had set a new, almost unreachable standard.

 

Clearing two dungeons in one night, both with SSS-level scores…

 

This wasn't just strong.

 

This was monstrous.

 

Teahouse

 

The Morwyn sisters had yet to log off, sipping tea while anxiously waiting for news of Fenric.

 

When the broadcast rang out, both sisters finally exhaled in relief.

 

Aurora's first thought was of the battle armor—Fenric must have used it flawlessly, or he wouldn't have survived outer space combat.

 

Belle's relief, however, came from pure concern.

 

Her beautiful face lit up with a smile, and she whispered in her heart:

 

"Shura… you did it again. Congratulations."

 

"Sis, I'm going to bed. Are you staying up?" Belle asked.

 

"No, I'll sleep too. The Samsara space will close soon anyway."

 

"Can I sleep in your room tonight?"

 

"Sure. But remember—you're cooking breakfast tomorrow."

 

While some rejoiced, many others felt only envy and frustration.

 

Across other Samsara Zones, faces grew dark upon hearing the broadcast.

 

Shura's rise was simply too terrifying.

 

Especially in Zone E, home turf of the Cindralock Dominion.

 

For years, Adam had been the undisputed number one. His dominance allowed Zone E Samsaras to bask in his shadow, reaping secondary rewards.

 

But now—Shura's meteoric rise was making Adam's throne look unstable.

 

"Damn it! Where the hell did this Shura come from?"

 

"Why isn't a talent like him in our Dominion?"

 1

"What's our Intelligence Bureau even doing? We should have identified and crushed this threat early!"

 

"Have they even uncovered his true identity yet? Those idiots are useless!"

 

"Mr. Adam's been quiet for too long… I hope he clears the 33rd floor soon and seizes Samsara Tower authority!"

 

"Right. If Adam claims that authority, no one—not even Shura—can surpass him!"

comments.content: I hope that supposed 'authority' that you gain on the 33rd floor isn't what everyone thinks. I mean, absolutely everyone thinks that whoever gets there first becomes the admin, and there's no proof of that theory—it's all baseless rumors. I think it should be something like completing the beginner's tutorial and becoming a real player. The 33rd floor is far too early to be given absolute authority.

chapters.name: Chapter 180: Chapter 180: Comprehensive Evaluation Reaches A! (4/8)
chapters.content:
"Dear Samsara Playe—Shura, you have completed your mission. Your rewards are as follows:"

 

Samsara Points: 45,000

 

Agility +30 (Added)

 

Temporary Perception Card x1 (Stored in your personal warehouse)

 

Golden Treasure Box (Stored in your personal warehouse)

 

Fenric frowned slightly at the system's announcement.

 

On the surface, this reward seemed less substantial compared to what he had gained in the 2012 dungeon.

 

But the real mystery was what the Golden Treasure Box would contain.

 

He immediately opened his personal warehouse.

 

First, he examined the Temporary Perception Card.

 

[Temporary Perception Card]

 

Effect: After use, the user's comprehension will be greatly enhanced for a short duration, allowing them to instantly grasp any technique or ability.

 2

Note: This is a one-time-use card.

 

Fenric's eyes brightened.

 

This is a treasure!

 

With this card, he could instantly master any martial art or advanced skill he wanted in the future.

 

He carefully stored it away, then turned his attention to the Golden Treasure Box and opened it.

 

"Congratulations! You have opened the Golden Treasure Box and obtained a special item: Mjolnir (Enhanced Version)!"

 7

A majestic hammer appeared inside the box. Fenric's eyes widened.

 

Thor's Hammer?!

 

Wasn't this the legendary weapon of Thor Odinson?

 

And what did "Enhanced Version" mean?

 

He picked up the hammer, and another prompt appeared:

 

[Special Item: Mjolnir (Enhanced Version)]

 

Effect: Grants the wielder the power to control thunder and lightning. You can summon sky lightning to strike your enemies.

 

Note: Controlling lightning with Mjolnir consumes mental power. Use it wisely!

 3

Fenric stood there, momentarily stunned.

 

This effect is practically identical to Thor's own hammer!

 1

Next time he entered an Avengers dungeon… what would happen if he ran into Thor?

 

Would there be two Gods of Thunder?

 2

Regardless, this hammer was a tremendous asset—owning it was equivalent to gaining a whole new power over lightning.

 

In Avengers: Endgame, even Captain America had wielded this hammer to fight on par with Thanos, which showed just how powerful it was.

 1

Overall, Fenric was very satisfied with the rewards from this mission.

 

Fenric then began converting his gains.

 

First, he sold back his unused Ark Ferry Ticket retrieving another 65,000 Samsara Points.

 3

Adding the 45,000 from the mission, he now had 110,000 Samsara Points!

 

Without hesitation, he exchanged everything for potential points—a total of 220 points.

 2

He distributed them carefully among his four main attributes:

 

Name: Shura

 

Samsara Number: (Zone C) 90086

 

Physique: 200 → 251

 

Spirit: 400 → 502

 

Strength: 303 → 349

 

Agility: 200 → 251

 

Potential Points: 0

 

Skills:

 

English (Proficient)

 

Driving (Beginner)

 

Shooting (Proficient)

 

Camouflage (Master)

 

Basic Swordsmanship Technique (Proficient)

 

Special Skills:

 

Conqueror's Haki (Advanced)

 4

Armament Haki (Mastery)

 

Combat Techniques:

 

Savage Charge

 

Abilities:

 

Telekinesis

 

Hundred Poisons Immunity (Passive)

 

Samsara Points: 22

 

Comprehensive Evaluation: B

 3

Fenric reviewed his stats.

 

His strength was now formidable.

 

However, what surprised him was that holding Mjolnir instantly increased his comprehensive evaluation from B to A!

 2

This confirmed that certain powerful special items could raise one's evaluation level.

 

To test further, Fenric picked up the Black Blade Shusui.

 

His evaluation also rose to A, but not as significantly as with Mjolnir.

 

This meant Fenric's current strength was already at the threshold of A-tier, just a small step away from officially reaching it.

 

Not bad—considering he had only just cleared the Sixth Stage of the Samsara Tower.

 

His power at this stage could already shock countless Samsara players.

 

[Attention all Samsaras: The Samsara Space will close in 5 minutes.]

 

Hearing the system prompt, Fenric decided to log off.

 

Back to Reality

 

Returning to his room in the real world, he felt a wave of mental exhaustion.

 

The battles in the Avengers dungeon had been intense, and his mind was drained.

 

Still, he was deeply satisfied.

 

Meanwhile, on the other side of the globe—

 

In the Cindralock Dominion, daylight had already broken.

 

In a massive, high-security conference hall, the Director of the Intelligence Bureau, the Minister of Defense, and several influential senators were already seated.

 

Moments later, the President himself arrived to chair the meeting.

 

After a brief silence, a middle-aged man in a major general's uniform entered the room.

 

He was tall and imposing, with sharp, hawk-like eyes that exuded power and dominance.

 

Though he had only recently been promoted to major general, no one dared show the slightest displeasure at his late arrival.

 

Because this man was none other than Adam.

 

Real name: Will Statham.

 2

The living legend—the "God" of Zone E's Samsaras.

 

"Sorry for being late. I just returned from the Samsara space," Adam said politely.

 

This man was cunning—despite his unparalleled strength, he never acted arrogant.

 

He knew well that even he couldn't survive a nuclear strike, so he maintained a careful, low-key demeanor.

 4

"No problem, Will. We just arrived ourselves," an elder congressman said with a smile, eager to curry favor.

 

Adam nodded gratefully and took his seat, positioned directly beneath the Minister of Defense—higher than even veteran generals.

 

"Now that everyone is present, let's begin," the President said, his tone serious.

 

"I assume you've all heard the news. Shura of C Zone has received two SSS evaluations today."

 

______

 

[Translator's note:

 

Advance Chapters on Patreon!

 

If you'd like to read 1–3 arcs ahead of the Webnovel release schedule, you can now do so on my Patreon! Daily updates on Webnovel will still continue at the usual pace.

 

Patreon: patreon.com/LazySeeker

 

Thank you all for your continued support!]

chapters.name: Chapter 181: Chapter 181: Ambitious Adam! (5/8)
chapters.content:
The focus of this high-level meeting in the Cindralock Dominion was clear— Shura.

 

"This man is rising far too quickly. He's becoming a threat to us, and we must stop him as soon as possible!"

 1

The President's firm tone set the tone for the discussion.

 

"Any updates from the Intelligence Bureau?" he asked.

 

The Director of Intelligence hesitated before replying, "Not yet. The target remains extremely low-key in real life. Please give us more time."

 

The President's face darkened with dissatisfaction.

 

A white-haired congressman sneered, "Give you more time? At this rate, no one will be able to stop Shura!"

 

The Director remained silent, unable to argue. He had been tasked by the President to uncover Shura's real identity, yet he had made no progress. He wasn't in a position to refute anyone.

 

"Why can't we try recruiting him?" someone suggested.

 

"We already tried. He refused."

 

"Perhaps our offer wasn't tempting enough? I don't believe anyone can resist the right price!"

 

"Don't count on it. Based on our intel, Shura is a loner. He refuses to align with any faction."

 

Another voice added cautiously, "I heard Shura plans to guide someone through a trial tonight. Maybe we could target that person?"

 

"Absolutely not! That person is related to the woman ranked just below Adam. If we touch her, it could start a war among Samsara players!"

 

"..."

 

The conference room filled with heated debate as various strategies were discussed.

 

The President finally interjected with a cold voice:

 

"Gentlemen, use your cunning as you would in business. If we don't stop Shura, he will become a direct threat to our power!"

 

Many attendees rolled their eyes inwardly. Did he have to put it so bluntly?

 1

At that moment, the Director of Intelligence spoke up, "Sir, I've received information that Shura is having that woman purchase a large number of Dungeon Cooldown Refresh Cards for him. He intends to clear dungeons daily. We can interfere with this plan!"

 

"How do you propose we stop him?"

 

"We can dispatch our own people to Zone C to buy out the cooldown refresh cards in bulk, making it harder for him to obtain them. If we drive up the price and control the supply, we might slow down his progress. It won't stop his rise entirely, but it will delay him!"

 

"..."

 

"..."

 

The room fell silent for a moment as everyone processed the idea.

 

Then, their eyes lit up.

 

"This plan is good. Implement it immediately!" the President ordered.

 

It was the only feasible strategy for now.

 

The rules of Samsara Space were too strict—killing could only occur inside a dungeon.

 

High-tier Samsara players like Adam could no longer enter low-level dungeons.

 

And in the same-tier dungeons, who could possibly match Shura?

 

After finalizing the plan, the meeting adjourned.

 

The President, however, asked Adam to stay behind and escorted him to the private study in the White House.

 

"General Will, please, have a seat."

 

The President's tone was polite, almost respectful.

 

"Mr. President, do you need something from me?" Adam asked, sitting down calmly.

 

"I heard you're planning to attempt the 31st floor of the Samsara Tower?"

 

Adam nodded. "Yes."

 

"Are you confident? If you're not, don't take the risk. You know how important your existence is to us, Will."

 

Adam smiled faintly. "Don't worry, sir. If I weren't confident, I wouldn't act rashly."

 

"Good. Stay safe."

 1

Adam rose from his seat, "If there's nothing else, Mr. President, I'll take my leave."

 

"Alright, until next time."

 

As Adam walked out of the study, a cold glint flickered in his eyes.

 

The President might act as though he cares, but deep down, he's afraid. Afraid of me becoming too strong… too uncontrollable.

 

Adam sneered inwardly. These politicians are terrified of me.

 

But their fear would not stop him.

 

He would break through the 33rd floor of the Samsara Tower, seize its authority, and ascend to the position of a true "God."

 

Then, he would trample these politicians beneath his feet!

 

Morning – Fenric's Side

 

Fenric was woken up by his father.

 

"Ric, it's eight o'clock! Why aren't you at school yet?"

 

"Overslept," Fenric replied casually. Then, noticing the tired look on his father's face, he asked, "What's wrong? Haven't you resigned yet?"

 

"Not yet," Father Eric said with a weary smile. "The boss hasn't found a replacement, so I'll be working for a few more days."

 3

Fenric sighed and shook his head. "I'm heading to school."

 

Everyone had their own path to follow.

 

Fenric had already given him a million as compensation, but his father was stubborn. There was no point in arguing about it anymore.

 

After grabbing a quick breakfast on the way, Fenric walked to school.

 

Truthfully, he wanted to test Mjolnir's power, but its destructive potential was far too great. He decided to hold off for now.

 

By the time he arrived, it was already nine in the morning—clearly late.

 

Fortunately, the college entrance exam was only four days away, and the teachers were too focused on review sessions to bother about punctuality.

 

When Fenric entered the classroom, he heard many students still buzzing about Shura's legendary feat from last night.

 

He simply smiled and ignored them.

 

Compliments were nice once or twice, but after hearing them endlessly, they lost their charm.

 1

The fat boy Jitto hadn't shown up at school today—wherever he was, Fenric didn't care much.

 1

He took out his phone and started browsing.

 

As expected, "Shura" was trending everywhere online.

 

Three SSS-rated accomplishments in one night—Shura had taken the gaming world by storm.

 

The internet was flooded with praise.

 

Fenric skimmed through the comments briefly before heading straight to the Samsara Forum, opening the Strategy Section.

 

There, he found a guide for the 7th Stage of the Samsara Tower.

 

When Fenric saw the names of the two dungeons available on that floor, he froze.

chapters.name: Chapter 182: Chapter 182: Kung Fu Hustle and Midnight Ring! (6/8)
chapters.content:
According to the official guide,

 

the Seventh Stage of the Samsara Tower offers two dungeon options:

 

The "Normal" difficulty dungeon: Kung Fu Hustle.

 3

The "Difficult" difficulty dungeon: Midnight Ring.

 7

When Fenric saw the names of these two dungeons, he was momentarily stunned.

 

These worlds were far too familiar to him.

 

With almost no hesitation, Fenric made his choice for this mission: "Kung Fu Hustle."

 

Though it was labeled as a "normal" difficulty dungeon and would naturally yield fewer rewards, Fenric wasn't after rewards this time.

 

From the moment he saw the name "Kung Fu Hustle," his decision was sealed.

 2

Fenric opened the official guide to review the details:

 

"There are two dungeons on the Seventh Stage of the Samsara Tower: the normal-level Kung Fu Hustle, and the difficult-level Midnight Ring."

 

The guide continued:

 

"Let's start with the difficult dungeon, Midnight Ring."

 

"In my personal opinion, its difficulty is comparable to The Mountain Village Old Corpse. If your mental fortitude is lacking, I strongly advise you not to enter this dungeon."

 

"The mission objective is simple: survive."

 

"Upon entering, you'll find an old TV, a broken-down DVD player, and a videotape. Once the tape is played, you will be cursed. A vengeful spirit named Sadako will mark you."

 8

Fenric stopped reading. He had no intention of dealing with Sadako.

 

Instead, he skipped directly to the strategy guide for "Kung Fu Hustle."

 

Truthfully, Fenric knew the world of "Kung Fu Hustle" far better than any official guide could explain.

 

Still, he wanted to confirm whether the system had altered the plot.

 

"Now, let's discuss the normal-level dungeon Kung Fu Hustle."

 

"Don't underestimate it. While it isn't horror-based like Midnight Ring, the world of Kung Fu Hustle is filled with martial arts masters. A single wrong encounter could prove fatal."

 

"The dungeon's background is a world where industrial development is just beginning. Technology is primitive—comparable to our world eighty years ago."

 

"The dungeon mission revolves around fame. Your reputation—whether good or bad—must spread. There is no distinction between good and evil. As long as your name is widely known, you can complete the task."

 

"Mission requirement: Gain at least 10,000 fame points within one month!"

 

"Based on player speculation, one fame point equals recognition from one individual. In other words, your name must be known by at least 10,000 people."

 

"All Samsara players will start in a city called Eastern Light. This city is dominated by a powerful organization known as the Axe Gang."

 

"It's recommended to join the Axe Gang. Anyone who has made it to the Seventh Stage should at least have a C-level overall strength rating. With your skills, joining them won't be a challenge."

 

"How do you build fame? The simplest method is to help the Axe Gang expand their territory, ensuring other gangs know your name."

 

The tone of the guide suddenly became stern:

 

"Pay close attention to this: The Axe Gang's ambition is to conquer all of Eastern Light. However, there's one area you must avoid—the Pig Sty Walled City. It's extremely dangerous and filled with masters."

 

"If the Axe Gang assigns you to the Pig Sty Walled City, I strongly advise you to behave respectfully. Don't provoke anyone there. Pretend, survive, and leave as quickly as possible."

 

The guide then listed the city's residents:

 

"The burly man carrying sandbags daily is called Coolie. His specialty is the Twelve Kick expert—one kick can shatter a concrete wall!"

 1

"The frail-looking old man at the tailor shop wields an iron fist with terrifying power!"

 

"The middle-aged man practicing with a staff is a master of Bagua staff technique. His stick technique is flawless, like flowing water."

 1

"Based on analysis from veteran players, the combined strength of these three easily exceeds C-level and edges close to B-level!"

 

"Moreover, the landlords of Pig Sty Walled City—a mysterious couple—are even stronger. The husband is a Tai Chi master, while the wife possesses a devastating soundwave technique (Lion's Roar Gong). Their power is undoubtedly beyond B-level!"

 3

"As for other hidden masters? Unknown for now."

 

"Warning again: Unless you are absurdly strong, do not challenge the Pig Sty Walled City. Your ending will be disastrous."

 

After finishing the guide, Fenric frowned slightly.

 

There was no mention of "Fire Cloud Evil God" or "Sing", the protagonist with unparalleled talent."

 

Could it be because the mission only lasts one month, leaving no time for them to appear?

 

Fenric's eyes gleamed with a trace of anticipation.

 

A plan quickly formed in his mind.

 

Fenric wasn't interested in the standard rewards from this dungeon.

 

If he wanted high-tier rewards, he would've chosen Midnight Ring.

 

The real reason he chose "Kung Fu Hustle" was the beggar—and more importantly, the "Buddha Palm Technique" technique in Sing's hands.

 6

Conveniently, he had obtained a Temporary Perception Card from the previous dungeon.

 2

This card would be crucial for mastering the Buddha Palm Technique tonight!

 6

Fenric turned off his phone, picked up a pen and a stack of white paper, and began sketching.

 

He was practicing drawing the beggar's likeness.

 

At first, the sketches were rough and unrecognizable.

 

But after hours of practice, the images started taking shape.

 

By late afternoon, dozens of sheets were scattered around him, each more refined than the last.

 

The final drawings bore an uncanny resemblance to the beggar from Kung Fu Hustle—

 

the very one who tricked Sing with the fake "Buddha Palm Technique" manual when he was a child.

 

Midnight.

 

At exactly 12:00 AM, Fenric entered Samsara Space once again.

chapters.name: Chapter 183: Chapter 183: Someone Is Targeting You! (7/8)
chapters.content:
"You have a new communication request. Aurora Morwyn is inviting you to a video call. Please respond promptly."

 

Not long after entering Samsara Space, Fenric received the system notification.

 

He smiled faintly and chose to connect.

 

"Aurora, I was just about to look for you. I've got what you wanted," Fenric said.

 

On the screen, Aurora smiled warmly.

 

"Shura, thank you so much. And congratulations! You earned another super-god evaluation last night!"

 

"Don't be so formal. You've helped me a lot too. Helping you a little is nothing."

 

Fenric's words came from the heart.

 

Becoming friends with Aurora had benefited him immensely.

 

Her high status, vast connections, and abundant resources were invaluable.

 

The Mark VI armor he was handing over—despite its advanced technology—was just another toy to him. Fenric already had superior equipment. Giving this set to Aurora would allow her to make better use of it and gain new achievements.

 

"Shura, your accomplishments in Samsara Space are truly unprecedented," Aurora said with admiration.

 

"Between us, there's no need for such words. Do you want the armor now? If so, I'll give it to you right away."

 

"Then I'll trouble you." Aurora smiled. "Would you like to come over for some tea?"

 

Fenric shook his head.

 

"No need. I'm about to enter a dungeon. Drinking tea every day is boring—let's just meet at the Trading Center."

 

"Alright, that works too."

 

After ending the call, the two met at the Trading Center.

 

Under the notarization of the Samsara system, Fenric transferred the Mark VI Armor to Aurora.

 2

"Shura, thank you."

 

Aurora wasn't overly excited when she saw the armor.

 

As expected, women's interests were different from men's.

 

She hadn't requested the armor for herself but for her organization's needs.

 

Special items could indeed be used in the real world.

 

As long as they weren't transferred to other Samsara players outside the system, the Samsara rules would not interfere.

 

"Between us, there's no need for thanks," Fenric said. "We'll probably be helping each other a lot in the future. If we thank each other every time, it would be troublesome."

 

Aurora chuckled softly.

 

"Fair enough. If you need my help, just say so."

 

Fenric nodded. "Good. Then I'll head to the dungeon now."

 

"Wait, Shura. I need to tell you something!"

 

Aurora's expression turned serious.

 

"Someone's targeting you. Certain forces have sent many Samsara players to purchase large numbers of dungeon cooldown refresh cards in Area C. The price of a single card has already been driven up to 2,000 Samsara points."

 1

"A few people were supposed to hand over their cards to you today, but they've suddenly changed their minds. They want to resell the cards at these inflated prices instead."

 

"..."

 

Hearing this, a cold glint flashed in Fenric's eyes.

 

2,000 points meant little to him, but to most Samsara people, that was a fortune.

 1

He couldn't win a price war alone.

 

Even with his ability to earn points, he couldn't outmatch an organized force.

 

If they sent a hundred Samsara players to buy up cards, the market would be cornered, and Fenric would be forced to pause his plans.

 

He could afford to buy one or two cards at 2,000 points, but bulk purchases would quickly drain his resources.

 

"Who's behind this?" Fenric asked coldly.

 

"It should be the Cindralock Dominion," Aurora replied.

 1

Fenric gave a small nod, silently taking note of the grudge.

 

"I can use my contacts to get you a few more cooldown refresh cards," Aurora said. "But at most, I can probably secure five. Any more would be difficult."

 3

"Alright, that's more than enough for now. I still have two on hand."

 

"Shura, didn't you just say we shouldn't be so polite?" Aurora Morwyn teased.

 

"Then I'll stop being polite."

 

Fenric smiled faintly.

 

After a brief pause, Aurora's curiosity got the better of her.

 

"Shura, I'm really curious. What's your current comprehensive strength rating? Rumor has it that you've reached A-level. Is that true?"

 

Fenric raised an eyebrow.

 

"Who's spreading that rumor?"

 

"It's from the people who ran the Avengers dungeon with you last night. They claimed they saw you kill one of the giant Chitauri beasts with a single punch. They even compared your strength to the Hulk. Based on your performance, they suspect your evaluation has broken into A-level."

 

Aurora Morwyn added in a lower voice, "This is why the Cindralock Dominion is going after you. You're rising too fast."

 

Fenric shook his head.

 

"Just rumors. My strength hasn't reached A-level yet."

 

He showed her the full moon emblem on his arm, where his current rating still displayed B.

 

Aurora exhaled with relief.

 

"Good. If you'd already reached A-level strength on the Seventh Stage, that would be terrifying."

 1

Fenric didn't reply.

 

Though his official rating was B, with Thor's Hammer in hand, he could easily surpass A-level. In real combat, he could stand toe-to-toe with any A-level master.

 

"One more thing," Aurora said gravely.

 

"Domestic spies have been very active lately. Some have even hacked into the database, likely trying to uncover your real identity. Shura, you should keep a low profile for now."

 

"Got it," Fenric nodded.

 

But inwardly, his determination to grow stronger burned even brighter.

 

With enough strength, what would there be to fear?

 

"By the way, Shura, which dungeon are you tackling on the Seventh Stage tonight?"

 

"Kung Fu Hustle," Fenric answered.

 

Aurora blinked in surprise.

 

"I thought you'd choose the harder Midnight Ring!"

chapters.name: Chapter 184: Chapter 184: This Is the World of Kung Fu Hustle! (8/8)
chapters.content:
"Shura, I truly envy you," Morwyn said softly. "The higher you climb the Samsara Tower, the more difficult the tasks become. Without sufficient strength, it's impossible to clear the dungeons. Many Samsara players get stuck on a certain floor, paralyzed by uncertainty, too afraid to even attempt the next challenge.

 

The foundation of every Samsara player is crucial—and, Shura, no one in the entire Samsara Space can compare to you in that regard."

 

She smiled faintly. "I hope you continue to persevere and aim for a peak we can only dream of reaching."

 

After parting ways with Aurora, Fenric headed to his personal warehouse.

 

"System, can damaged special items be repaired?" he asked.

 

The system's mechanical voice replied, "Yes."

 

Fenric's gaze fell on the Mark VII Armor, its surface still marred by battle damage.

 

"What do I need to repair this?" he asked.

 

During the Avengers dungeon, the armor had taken a direct hit from a Chitauri mothership energy cannon, leaving it severely damaged. It was still functional but could break under heavy strain.

 

"Repairing a special item requires 500 Samsara Points per instance," the system replied.

 

Fenric let out a breath of relief.

 

"Five hundred points? That's not bad."

 

He decided he would use the armor for one or two more runs before repairing it.

 

Next, Fenric entered his personal dungeon world, The Great Wall. He hadn't visited his betrothed, Lin Mei, in several days.

 3

After spending some time with her, he returned to the Samsara Tower.

 1

The time was 1:30 a.m.

 

Thanks to Aurora's connections, he had obtained three dungeon cooldown refresh cards yesterday. Combined with the two already in his possession, he was well-prepared.

 

At the gate of the Samsara Tower, Fenric activated a cooldown refresh card without hesitation and stepped forward.

 

He was immediately transported to the Seventh Stage.

 

The Tower Spirit appeared in front of him, her form materializing from thin air.

 

"Hello, dear Samsara Player, Shura. How may I assist you?"

 

"I want to enter the dungeon," Fenric replied.

 

"Very well. Please select the world you wish to enter."

 

With a graceful wave of the spirit's hand, a holographic screen appeared before him.

 

The screen displayed two available dungeon worlds:

 

Kung Fu Hustle (Normal)

 

Midnight Ring (Difficult)

 

Fenric's goal was clear. Without hesitation, he selected Kung Fu Hustle.

 

As he confirmed the selections, he was instantly teleported into a stark white preparation room.

 

Only a dozen Samsara players were present.

 

When Fenric appeared, the room grew noticeably tense.

 

"Holy sh*t… that's Shura!" someone exclaimed.

 

"What's going on? Why would the great Shura be here for a normal dungeon? Shouldn't he be taking on the difficult ones?"

 

"Maybe… maybe even he's unsure about the difficult dungeon?"

 

"Doesn't this feel off? The great Shura running a normal dungeon? It doesn't match his reputation!"

 

"Damn it, with Shura here, our chances of gaining fame points just got crushed. I'm thinking of backing out. Monkey, what about you?"

 

"I'm staying. I need to hit B-level as soon as possible so my father can get better treatment."

 2

"I'm leaving. With Shura here, there's no way I'll get enough fame."

 

"Don't be so hasty. Following Shura might not be a bad idea. If he eats meat, we might at least get some broth. Hardly anyone survives Pig Sty Alley in Kung Fu Hustle. Maybe Shura can lead us through!"

 

"True! I heard in last night's Avengers dungeon, thanks to Shura drawing all the Chitauri firepower, several Samsara players achieved A-level evaluations—and two even got S-level!"

 1

"For real? If that's the case, I'll stick around."

 

"Same. As long as we don't provoke him, we'll complete the mission easily."

 

Fenric overheard their chatter and sighed inwardly.

 

Has my reputation really grown this much?

 3

Some Samsara players even canceled their plans, choosing to wait for the next rotation rather than compete with him for fame points.

 

Too lazy to care, Fenric found a corner, sat down, and closed his eyes to rest.

 

Soon, the countdown began.

 

"Attention, Samsaras: teleportation to the mission world begins in 10 minutes."

 

There were now twelve Samsara players in the preparation room, including Fenric.

 

The final 10 minutes passed swiftly.

 

"Teleportation countdown: 10… 9… 8… 3… 2… 1!"

 

Red light enveloped everyone, and the white room vanished.

 

"Come! Fresh meat buns, piping hot!"

 

"Miracle cure ancestral bone remedy, heals trauma instantly! Come and get it!"

 

"Fortune-telling! A thousand coins per character! Discounted to ten today—no accuracy, no payment!"

 

When Fenric opened his eyes, he was standing in the middle of a bustling street.

 

Vendors lined both sides, their stalls filled with snacks, herbs, and trinkets. The setting was unmistakably old-fashioned—an era reminiscent of the 90s period.

 

Men in short jackets pulled rickshaws, sweating as they hauled passengers through the streets. Occasionally, a Westerner in a tuxedo and top hat could be seen riding past.

 

Fenric's lips curved into a small smile.

 

This is one of the true perks of Samsara Space—the chance to experience the atmosphere of different worlds firsthand.

 

A crisp chime rang out.

 

"Main Mission Released!"

 

– Mission: Gain at least 10,000 fame points within 30 days.

 

– Time Limit: 30 days.

 

– Failure Penalty: Obliteration.

 

– Note: The higher the fame you accumulate, the higher your mission evaluation will be.

chapters.name: Chapter 185: Chapter 185: Shura vs. Fire Cloud!
chapters.content:
Fenric's expression remained calm as the mission prompt echoed in his mind.

 

To be honest, such a task might be troublesome for other Samsaras.

 

But for him?

 

This was nothing.

 

If Fenric wanted to make a name for himself here, it would be all too easy—just kill a few major figures, and fame would naturally follow.

 

With his current strength, no one in this world could stop him from doing whatever he wanted.

 

Perhaps the "Star Boy" in the future could pose a challenge, but right now, that boy hadn't even mastered the Buddha Palm Technique—he was still just an immature brat.

 

(Note: He's talking about the MC of the story. From his name Sing means Star and he's still in his teens. A boy.)

 

Fenric strolled into a foreign-style furniture store.

 

The shop was filled with imported Western furniture, expensive and considered high-class in this era.

 

Stopping before a full-length mirror, Fenric examined his reflection.

 

Black hair.

 

Black eyes.

 

Sharp features.

 

The system had given him a default appearance that resembled his real self by about thirty percent, but his body proportions were identical to his own.

 

"Sir, what can I help you with?" the shopkeeper asked warmly.

 

Fenric's current attire—a perfectly tailored tuxedo—gave him the air of a wealthy, successful man.

 

"I just have a question," Fenric replied, his tone polite.

 

The shopkeeper blinked in mild surprise but answered with equal politeness, "Please ask, sir. If it's something I know, I'll gladly tell you."

 

"I'm new here," Fenric said with a smile. "I heard there's a hospital nearby called the Abnormal Human Research Center. Do you know where it is?"

 

That's right. Fenric was looking for Fire Cloud.

 

The mission could wait. Before anything else, he wanted to test the true strength of martial arts in this world.

 

And among all martial artists here, the most formidable one was undoubtedly Fire Cloud, once ranked number one on the assassin list.

 

As for the Star Boy who would later awaken terrifying skill, he would only appear when Pig Sty Alley was on the verge of destruction.

 

—--

 

The shopkeeper gave Fenric a wary glance but still pointed down the street.

 

"Sir, just keep going until you reach the end—you'll see it."

 

"Much appreciated," Fenric said with a faint smile.

 

At that moment, several men in black suits entered the shop.

 

They all had axes tucked at their waists, with matching axe tattoos inked along their necks.

 

The shopkeeper's face immediately darkened.

 

"Shopkeeper," the lead man sneered, "time to pay this month's protection fee."

 

"Right away, right away!" The shopkeeper hurried to the counter, abandoning Fenric and scrambling to retrieve several silver notes.

 

Fenric merely glanced at the scene and turned to leave.

 

He'd seen the original movie. He knew well how notorious the Axe Gang was.

 

Killing on the streets was trivial to them.

 

Even after a massacre, the local police would still come out—not to arrest them, but to clean up the mess.

 

If the plot timeline was accurate, the Crocodile Gang had already been wiped out. The Axe Gang now ruled SH City.

 

Fenric walked leisurely down the bustling street, taking in the scenery.

 

The sights of the country's past era had their own charm—rickshaw pullers hauling passengers, vendors hawking goods, and locals in old-fashioned robes.

 

A small street stall selling sweets caught his eye.

 

The vendor was a clean, delicate-looking young woman with a gentle aura. She smiled warmly at the children crowding her stall, handing them candy despite being unable to speak.

 

The mute girl.

 1

Fenric instantly recognized her.

 

Though she had little screen time in the original plot, she was still the story's heroine.

 

He chuckled faintly but didn't approach.

 

He was merely passing through.

 

—--

 

After an hour, Fenric finally reached the end of the street, arriving at a secluded area.

 

Before him stood a three-story building, flanked by foreign soldiers on guard.

 

Fenric's eyes sharpened.

 

This must be it. Fire Cloud is hiding here.

 

He walked straight toward the entrance.

 

"Stop!"

 

Two soldiers stepped forward, rifles raised. One barked in English, "No trespassing! Leave immediately!"

 

Fenric didn't even spare them a second glance. With a simple wave of his hand, the two burly men were sent flying.

 

With his current telekinetic abilities, handling ordinary humans was laughably easy.

 

A sharp whistle pierced the air—an alarm.

 

Moments later, dozens of soldiers armed with rifles stormed toward him.

 

But none could get close. One by one, they were sent sprawling through the air as Fenric walked on, unfazed.

 

"Fire!"

 

Gunshots rang out.

 

Bad move.

 

If they didn't fire, they'd live. But now…

 

Pfft! Pfft!

 

Bullets whizzed back toward their shooters. The soldiers who pulled the trigger were instantly killed, collapsing into pools of blood.

 

Fenric strode through the chaos, entering the mental hospital.

 

The building wasn't tall, but it sprawled across a large area. Fenric remembered that Fire Cloud resided in a deep basement room—but he wasn't entirely sure how to get there.

 

Just then, a foreign officer in a white uniform rushed over.

 

With a flick of Fenric's hand, the man's body was yanked forward like a ragdoll, slamming into Fenric's grip.

 

"Tell me where Fire Cloud is," Fenric said calmly.

 

The officer's eyes went wide as he saw his own gun floating mid-air, its barrel aimed at him. His face turned pale.

 

"Sir… I—I don't know who Fire Cloud is!" he stammered.

 

Fenric frowned. He must be living under an alias.

 

"Take me to the basement," Fenric ordered.

 

"Yes, sir! Please, this way!" the officer said hastily, leading the way.

 

—-

 

A few minutes later, they arrived at the dark, damp basement.

 

"Sir, the people detained here are all extremely dangerous. May I leave now?"

 

"Go," Fenric said with a dismissive wave.

 

The officer bolted as though granted amnesty.

 

Fenric moved deeper into the basement. He remembered the movie's scenes well—Fire Cloud's room was at the far end, behind an iron door.

 

It didn't take long for him to find it.

 

There it was, just as he remembered.

 

A grin tugged at his lips.

 

"Found you."

 

With a single pull, he tore the heavy iron lock off the door.

 

Clang!

 

Inside the room sat a half-bald old man with reading glasses, nonchalantly sitting on the toilet, reading a newspaper… while doing his business.

 

(TL/n: Fire Cloud or The Beast is the old balding man in the pic.)

 4

_______

 

[Translator's Note:]

 

The First Arc of Marvel is officially complete! 

 1

Thank you all for reading and supporting this journey so far!

 

Now, let's talk about what's coming next — the Kung Fu Hustle!

 

Next Arc Deal 

 

+1,500 Power Stones = Full Release of the Entire Next Arc!

 

Chapter Update Rules & Ranking Changes 

 

We now have nearly 10,000 readers, so instead of tracking monthly rankings, we're aiming for the "All-Time" ranking from now on!

 

Rank 3: 5-Chapter Update!

 

Advance Chapters on Patreon!

 

If you'd like to read 1–3 arcs ahead of the Webnovel release schedule, you can now do so on my Patreon! Daily updates on Webnovel will still continue at the usual pace.

 

Patreon: patreon.com/LazySeeker

 

Thank you all for your continued support!

 

_______
